serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: A cloud-based AI inference platform that provides managed model deployment, autoscaling, and serving infrastructure for production machine learning workloads.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Repository for FedRAMP certification materials, SOC 2 Type II report, security policies, and supporting compliance evidence.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Agency personnel may request access through the access-request form on the Baseten trust center.

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: Secure deployment and configuration requirements for customers using the Baseten Inference Platform.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Reserved, autoscaling GPU/CPU compute for customer-owned and custom-trained models, deployed through Baseten's Truss framework. Customers get dedicated hardware, full deployment-lifecycle management, and multi-cloud capacity, suited for steady, latency-sensitive, or high-scale production inference workloads that need consistent performance and reliability.

Fully managed, serverless inference endpoints for popular open-source and frontier models, compatible with the OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages API formats. Billed per token with no dedicated infrastructure required from the customer, Model APIs are optimized and hosted by Baseten and are suited for variable-traffic workloads and rapid prototyping through production.

certified.useCase: Amazon Web Services (AWS US East/West) is the underlying public cloud infrastructure provider (compute, storage, networking, GPU capacity) hosting the Baseten Inference Platform within the assessment boundary.
